infoLinks.urlText: Camden diversions due to Christmas event
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 21 November
  • From 10am to midnight, Route 890c buses will divert due to road closures on John St for the Camden Christmas festival.  
  • Buses to Camden will end trips at temporary Bus Stop on Mitchell St opposite Camden Public School. Camden Public School, Mitchell St (2570269). 
  • Buses away from Camden will use Camden Public School, Mitchell St (2570269). A temporary Bus Stop on Mitchell St opposite Camden Public School. 
  • Stops on John St, Argyle St and Oxley St will be missed. 
  • Allow extra travel time and continue on foot.  
Closed and alternative stops:
  • John Street before Argyle Street (257011) will be closed – use the alternative stop at Camden Public School, Mitchell Street (2570269) and Mitchell Street, opp Camden Public School (2570489) 
  • Argyle Street at Elizabeth Street (257015) will be closed – use the alternative stop at Elizabeth Street at Argyle Street 
  • Oxley Street after Argyle Street (257065) will be closed – there will not be an alternative stop. Allow extra travel time and continue on foot 
  • St Paul’s Catholic School, John Street (2570310) will be closed - there will not be an alternative stop. Allow extra travel time and continue on foot
